classification_boundary: Model-facing development triage under RUN_PROTOCOL.md; not human validation, governance evidence, or a ratification recommendation.

construct_results.title: among-others / and-no-others — is the list the whole list?
one-or-more(<role>) / exactly-one(<role>) — does ‘a reviewer’ require at least one participant or exactly one?
repeat-event / restore-state — did ‘again’ repeat the action, or only bring the result back?
they-one / they-many — say whether ‘they’ is one actor or several
observed / reported(<by>) / inferred(<from>) - mark where a claim came from
attempt: / ensure: — say whether the instruction tolerates failure
